compiled_state.title: As a bridge operator, I want the at-most-one-dso_local_id invariant enforced with auto-filed bug tickets when violated, so that identity-anomalies surface as actionable tickets within one pass.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Invariant enforcement + anomaly alerting. Every pass scans for issues with >1 dso_local_id. On detection, appends bridge-alert and invokes /dso:fix-bug. Per-pass cap 5, 24h dedup.

## Done Definitions
- Each pass scans every Jira issue with dso_local_id; if >1 value present, appends to bridge_state/bridge_alerts/<date>.jsonl ← Satisfies: sc-5
- On violation, reconciler invokes /dso:fix-bug with templated bug body; bug ticket id recorded in bridge-alert entry ← Satisfies: sc-5
- Test harness writing second dso_local_id produces exactly one bridge-alert and one auto-filed bug ticket in next scheduled pass ← Satisfies: sc-5

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Per-pass cap (5) and 24h dedup are mandatory to prevent tracker flooding.
- [Security] /dso:fix-bug from GHA runner requires appropriate token scope.
- [Alert hygiene] bridge-alert dedup for at-most-one violations must use a per-Jira-issue dedup key (not just a per-day window) so that repeated violations of the same issue do not generate multiple bug tickets across days. Dedup key format: bridge-alert:at-most-one:<jira-issue-key>.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
